subject: public-administration
intro: Public administration leads into the machinery of government and the nonprofit sector — the people who write budgets, run programmes, steer emergencies and keep public services accountable.

roles.title: Emergency Management Directors
roles.what: Plan and direct disaster response and crisis management: prepare emergency plans and procedures for hurricanes, floods and other hazards, train staff and communities in preparedness, and coordinate agencies when a disaster actually strikes.
roles.where: Unit 2's policy process — agenda setting, implementation and evaluation — is the planning cycle behind emergency plans; unit 6's leadership and collaborative governance cover coordinating agencies; unit 8's service delivery grounds the response side.

roles.title: Budget Analysts
roles.what: Examine budget estimates for completeness, accuracy and conformance with procedures and regulations, analyse budgeting and accounting reports, and help public bodies decide what they can afford and where the money should go.
roles.where: Unit 3 is the direct match — budget processes and cycles, taxation and revenue, and debt, auditing and accountability — while unit 4's cost-benefit analysis is the evidence tool for weighing competing funding requests.

roles.title: Social and Community Service Managers
roles.what: Plan, direct and coordinate social service programmes and community outreach organisations — overseeing budgets and policies on who programmes serve and what they receive, and directing staff such as social workers, counsellors and probation officers.
roles.where: Unit 8's programme design, delivery and social equity mirror the core of the job; unit 4's statistics and programme data support evaluating what works; unit 7's accountability strand governs how publicly funded programmes report results.

roles.title: Administrative Services Managers
roles.what: Plan, direct and coordinate an organisation's administrative services — records and information management, mail distribution and other office support — so that agencies and companies run efficiently behind the scenes.
roles.where: Unit 5's managing public organisations — organisational behaviour, human resources and civil service, strategic management — supplies the toolkit; unit 3's budgeting covers the spending these managers administer; unit 8's digital government maps to records systems.
